title: Lusztig's special pieces conjecture
summary: Let $\mathcal O$ be a special nilpotent orbit in the Lie algebra $\mathfrak g$ of a simple algebraic group $G$. We give two proofs of the result that every special piece ${\mathcal P}(\mathcal O)$ in $\mathfrak g$ is the quotient of a smooth $G$-variety $X$ by the action of a certain finite group $H$. We first deduce the result from a similar result for transverse slices, established in earlier work of the first three authors and Fu. Then we give a more explicit construction of $X$, as a subvariety of the closure of a $G$-orbit in the direct sum of $\mathfrak g$ and some fundamental weight…
